verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੫ : ਉਹੀ ਭਾਵ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਦਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 15 : uhee bhaav baisa(n)tar dhaa dhirashaTaa(n)t

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਇਕ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਰਖ ਉਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: eik paanee ik dharat hai bahu birakh upaae|

en.bdb: The water is one and the earth is also one but the flora is of variegated qualities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਬਹੁ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਸੁਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: afal safal parakaar bahu fal ful suhaae|

en.bdb: Many are devoid of fruits and many are adorned with flowers and fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bahu ras ra(n)g suvaasanaa parakirat subhaae|

en.bdb: They have diverse kinds of fragrance  and by their many kinds of extracts they enhance the grandeur of Nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: baisa(n)tar ik varan hoi sabh taravar chhaae|

en.bdb: The same fire is there in all trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤਹੁ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਭਸਮੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gupatahu paragaT hoi kai bhasama(n)t karaae|

en.bdb: That unmanifest fire becoming manifest reduces all to ashes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰੱਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: aape aap vara'tadhaa gurmukh sukh paae ||15||

en.bdb: Likewise, that (unmanifest) Lord resides in all and this very fact makes Gurmukhs full of  delight.
